corrections.why: No source gives a structure height. The register gives the elevation as 2,038 m and the cab's base as nine feet; 209.1 m matches neither.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1915 notice shows a lookout on the peak before the CCC cab, and the 1936 notice of a new lookout house fits the 1937 date for the current cab.

notes_for_editor: Brief checks: elevation (2,037.9 m), coordinates and agency match the NHLR page. height_m 209.1 has no source; proposed removal above. The brief's 2017 event (FFLA 500-dollar restoration grant, from cr-ca-sierra-nevada-2017.pdf) is left out: that PDF returned no text through fetch_text and is unverified. Open conflicts: (a) the Forest Service's 1934 staffing start against the 1915 and 1936 notices; (b) the 1987 notice describes a former lookout station becoming the hut, while the FS describes the hut as sharing the summit, so which building is rented is unclear; (c) NHLR marks the site available for rental, while the FS guide says lookout use is not part of the hut rental. The Mountain Democrat article has no year in the fetched text, so the restoration is undated in the story. The FS rental guide is undated, so staffing status is as of an unknown date. No photos added. Fact-check 2026-10-08: the story no longer says a lookout has been on the summit 'since at least 1915'; the 1915 item is a notice that a man would go on duty. The Forest Service rental guide is undated, so its status is reported as of that guide, not today.
